# NOVO'S Cleaning

> NOVO'S Cleaning is a local, insured residential house cleaning company in Indianapolis, Indiana. We do deep cleans, move in and move out cleans, and standard (recurring) cleans with flat-rate pricing. Rated 4.8 stars on Google.

- Phone: (317) 489-0644 (call or text)
- Website: https://novoscleans.com
- Get a price online in 60 seconds: https://novoscleans.com/quote.html
- Service area: Indianapolis, Avon, Plainfield, Brownsburg, Zionsville, Whitestown, Carmel, Fishers, Westfield, Noblesville, McCordsville, Greenwood, Bargersville, Trafalgar, Fortville, Greenfield, New Palestine and Geist, Indiana

## Services and starting prices

- Deep clean: from $220. Full top to bottom reset. Our most booked clean.
- Move in / move out clean: from $250. Empty home, every room, ready for the walkthrough.
- Standard clean: from $120. Weekly, every other week or monthly upkeep.

Prices are flat and based on the size of the home, not hourly.

## How it works

1. See your price online or by phone.
2. We confirm by call or text and pick a time.
3. The crew brings all supplies. You don't need to be home. Your card is charged after the job is done.

## Policies

- Re-clean guarantee: report a missed spot within 48 hours and we re-clean it free.
- Cancellations: 24 hours' notice, otherwise a $40 fee.
- Recurring clients get $50 in credit after the first clean, plus a discount or credit back on every clean (weekly: 8% off or 7% credit; every other week: 5% off or 5% credit; monthly: 5% credit).
